blocking.title: Review & merge the three open PRs
blocking.detail: PR #69 license vendor CLI (issue #67), PR #70 release workflow + version bump script (issue #29), PR #71 this dashboard (issue #68). All tests green; each PR body lists what was verified.

blocking.title: Mint the production license keypair
blocking.detail: After merging PR #69: cd src-tauri && cargo run --bin license-tool -- keygen. Store the private key in your password manager, paste the printed PUBKEY array into src-tauri/src/license.rs, commit. The current embedded key's private seed was discarded after minting your own dev pro key, so no customer keys can be minted today — and re-keygening invalidates that dev key (mint yourself a fresh one). Only you should ever hold this key.

blocking.title: Decide: public repo or external hosting for downloads
blocking.detail: The repo is private. GitHub release assets and the Pages landing site are only public if the repo is public (or you host the DMG/landing elsewhere). This gates everything marketing-related.

blocking.title: Manual QA on your Mac (I run headless — cannot do this)
blocking.detail: Full pass: onboarding → pick a real folder → scan → Overview/Prompts/Detail → Settings each tab → AI fix with your real API key → apply fix → undo → git-branch commit option → tray menu → notifications → activate a license minted with the new keypair.

blocking.title: Tag and publish the first release
blocking.detail: After the above: pnpm bump <version> if desired, git tag v0.1.0 && git push origin v0.1.0, wait for the Release workflow, check the draft release's DMG installs and launches, then publish the draft and verify the landing page download link resolves.

marketing.title: Apple Developer Program — signing & notarization
marketing.detail: Without it the DMG triggers Gatekeeper warnings (right-click → Open still works; acceptable for early adopters, fatal for broad marketing). Enroll ($99/yr), create a Developer ID Application cert, then add repo secrets: APPLE_CERTIFICATE, APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD, APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY, APPLE_ID, APPLE_PASSWORD, APPLE_TEAM_ID. The release workflow picks them up automatically — no code change needed.

marketing.title: Deferred: set the Pro price & pick a payment provider
marketing.detail: Monetisation is paused (2026-08) — all gates are open, no purchase flow needed for now. When it resumes: pick a price, set up Gumroad / Lemon Squeezy / Polar, decide license delivery (manual mint via license-tool, or webhook automation), then update the landing pricing section.

marketing.title: Real screenshots / demo GIF for the landing page
marketing.detail: The landing uses abstract visuals. Capture the real app (Overview with a scanned repo, Detail with an AI fix) — needs your GUI session and a presentable real-world folder.

marketing.title: Pick launch channels & write the announce post
marketing.detail: Product Hunt, Hacker News (Show HN), X, r/ClaudeAI / r/cursor. Your voice, your call on positioning: 'linter for your prompt files' vs 'janitor for AI config sprawl'.

decisions.title: Version number for launch
decisions.detail: Ship as v0.1.0 (honest early-access) or v1.0.0 (marketing-friendly)? The bump script handles either.

decisions.title: Auto-update: in v1 or after?
decisions.detail: Tauri's updater needs its own signing keypair and an update manifest endpoint. Recommendation: ship v1 without it, add in v1.1 — early users will re-download.

decisions.title: Windows / Linux support
decisions.detail: Everything is Tauri so it's mostly build-matrix work, but tray/notification/QA effort is real. Post-v1 unless the market pulls for it.
